raw_segments.text: I am so sick of the young men of the present day," exclaimed she, rattling away at the
Poor, puny things not fit to stir a step beyond Papa's park gates, nor to go even so far
without Mama's permission and guardianship, creatures so absorbed in care about their
pretty faces, and their white hands, and their small feet, as if a man had anything to do
with beauty, as if loveliness were not the special prerogative of woman, her legitimate
I grant an ugly woman is a blot on the fair face of creation, but as to the gentlemen,
let them be solicitous to possess only strength and valor.
Let their motto be, Hunt, Shoot, and Fight.
The rest is not worth a fillip.
Such should be my device were I a man.
